messages:
Liam R: Heads-up: Growth wants to run a PLG microexperiment next week. Idea = 5 free credits vs 2 credits vs control, plus a prompt-template pack and an in-app activation nudge. Goal = bump 7-day retention by 10-15%. Who volunteers to own the landing + benchmarks, onboarding, routing, analytics? 
Priya S: I can do onboarding flows + emails. Suggest single-click sample in-app and 'start from template' CTA. Sequence: Day0 welcome + credits, Day1 template push, Day4 win-share. 
Marco T: I'll take landing + benchmark narrative. Plan to show dev time to first response (minutes), cost per 1k tokens, and memory/latency on standard sequences. We'll include a short 'how we measured' section. 
Jules M: I'll wire routing and sales alerts. SFDC should get a field activation_group. We should surface that in the utm_content. 
Liam R: Sounds good. Priya, can you draft the in-app nudge copy? Keep it micro. 
Priya S: Draft: "Get started: try 3 prompts with your credits → Open Quickstart" + small example templates inline. Will A/B test language (problem-focused vs curiosity). 
Marco T: Benchmark sketch: table with p50/p95 latency, tokens/response, cost per 1k tokens. Also include a tiny developer quickstart (curl + JS). 
Marco T: Quickstart snip: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-1","input":"Summarize this text"}'
```
Liam R: ops-bot, create calendar for a kickoff review Friday 10am PT. 
ops-bot: Event created "PLG microexperiment sync" Fri 10:00 PT. Invitees: @marketing @growth. 
Jules M: For routing webhook example: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.example/lead -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{email}","activation_group":"credit-5"}'
```
Marco T: I will draft the landing headline and hero stat by Thurs. Priya, coordinate on template pack naming. 
Liam R: Owners: landing+benchmarks: Marco; onboarding+emails: Priya; routing+SFDC: Jules; analytics+alerts: Marco & Jules. Sync Thurs EOD to validate tracking. :rocket:
